citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

citations.short: Buildings not maintained in good state of repair
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacturing, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product are not maintained in a good state of repair.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.
Written records of investigations into the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications do not always include the conclusions and follow-up.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.

Written procedures for cleaning and maintenance fail to include maintenance and cleaning schedules, description in sufficient detail of methods, equipment and materials used, description in sufficient detail of the methods of disassembling and reassembling equipment as necessary to assure proper cleaning and maintenance, and instructions for removal or obliteration of previous batch identification.
Input to and output from the computer are not checked for accuracy.
Written procedures are not followed for the receipt and identification of drug product containers and closures.

There are no written procedures for production and process controls designed to assure that the drug products have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.
Written procedures are not established that describe the in-process controls and tests to be conducted on appropriate samples of in-process materials of each batch.
Time limits are not established when appropriate for the completion of each production phase to assure the quality of the drug product.
The accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility of test methods have not been established.

citations.short: Results not used for expiration dates, storage cond.
citations.long: Results of stability testing are not used in determining expiration dates.

citations.short: Retention time for some OTC drugs
citations.long: OTC drug product reserve samples exempt from bearing an expiration date are not retained for three years after the lot or batch of drug product is distributed.

citations.short: Items to cover on annual reviews
citations.long: Written procedures are not established for evaluations done at least annually and including provisions for a review of complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations conducted for each drug product.

citations.short: Master production and control records, procedure
citations.long: The preparation of your master production and control records was not described in a written procedure.
The suitability of all testing methods is not verified under actual conditions of use.

citations.short: Test method modification records not maintained
citations.long: Complete records are not maintained of any modification of an established method employed in testing.

citations.short: Authority lacking to review records, investigate errors
citations.long: The quality control unit lacks authority to fully investigate errors that have occurred.
Employees engaged in the manufacture of a drug product lack the training required to perform their assigned functions.
Separate or defined areas to prevent contamination or mix-ups are deficient regarding operations related to the storage of drug products after release.
Written procedures are not established and followed for the cleaning and maintenance of equipment, including utensils, used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of a drug product.
Drug products do not bear an expiration date determined by appropriate stability data to assure they meet applicable standards of identity, strength, quality and purity at the time of use.
Written distribution procedures are not established.

citations.short: Quality control unit review of records
citations.long: Drug product production and control records, are not reviewed by the quality control unit to determine compliance with all established, approved written procedures before a batch is released or distributed.

Laboratory records do not include the initials or signature of a second person showing that the original records have been reviewed for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.

citations.short: Complaints reviewed by Quality Control Unit
citations.long: Written procedures describing the handling of complaints do not include provisions for review by the quality control unit of any complaint involving the possible failure of a drug product to meet any of its specifications and a determination as to the need for an investigation of any unexplained discrepancy.

citations.short: Buildings not maintained in good state of repair
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacturing, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product are not maintained in a good state of repair.

Written procedures are lacking which describe in sufficient detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, testing, approval, and rejection of components, drug product containers, and closures.

Records are not maintained so that data therein can be reviewed at least annually to evaluate the quality standards of each drug product to determine the need for changes in specifications or manufacturing or control procedures.
